caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of a patterned fabric positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The fabric features a checkered design with horizontal and vertical stripes in dark blue, brown, tan, green, and a lighter cream color. Across the checkered pattern, there are two horizontal bands consisting of red arrowhead shapes that run from the left to the right side of the fabric. Thin black lines are also visible as part of the stripe pattern. The fabric is neatly rendered with clear edges, and the drawing includes handwritten text at the bottom, including “Made by Mr. Barton” on the lower left and a number code “3-NH-1250-TE-2” on the lower right.
title: Quilt
